messages:
alex: Ran the nightly perf sweep for Llama2/3 variants after the kernel-routing tweak — seeing a regression for long-context requests (>=1k).

sophie: Can you paste the numbers?

alex: Quick summary: p50/p95 latency (ms) for generate with batch=4, temp=0.0, streaming off
```
Llama3-13B (master routing): seq128: 38/72  seq512: 110/260  seq1024: 320/980
Llama3-13B (new-selector): seq128: 36/68  seq512: 125/310  seq1024: 410/1300
Llama2-13B (baseline): seq128: 35/65  seq512: 108/240  seq1024: 300/850
```

mario: That p95 blow-up at 1k is rough. Any hot paths in profiler?

alex: Flamegraph shows attention kernel switching to non-fused path for head_dim=64/128 mismatch across some checkpoints. Also lots of KV-cache evict churn for long context. Snippet from profiler: 
```
0.0s - fused_attn_forward (fast)  12%
0.0s - attention_unfused_loop     34%  <-- increased
0.0s - kv_cache_lookup/evict      18%
0.0s - matmul_narrow_kernel       10%
```

jordan: I think rope_theta default is part of it. New-selector routes based on model.arch.meta that expects rope_theta=10000, but some Llama3 checkpoints use scaled theta => mismatch in rotary caching heuristics. That causes per-step recompute instead of cached rotations.

priya: If rotation caching fails we fall back to compute-heavy path and also can't reuse KV chunks across micro-batches. That explains both attention and kv_eviction stats.

mario: Any quick repro? Can run microbench on my node.

alex: Repro steps I used: 
```
# run microbench
./perf_runner --model llama3-13b --weights ./weights/llama3/variantA \
  --batch 4 --seq 1024 --profile --kernel-routing=autoselect
```

sophie: Also noticed RMSNorm vs LayerNorm changes in a few Llama2 checkpoints. RMSNorm codepath invokes elementwise SiLU in our fused norm kernel — different memory layout causes slower mem ops. Might be another axis.

jordan: TL;DR: two orthogonal issues -> (1) rope_theta/rotary mismatch causing recompute, (2) kernel selector heuristics picking non-fused matmul when head_dim not aligned.

priya: Proposed mitigations:
- add explicit rope_theta normalization step in model metadata fallback (cheap)
- loosen selector threshold so head_dim 64/128 picks fused kernels when sequence > 512
- fix KV eviction heuristic to prefer retaining recent prefixes for streaming/chat templates

alex: I opened a draft PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/2187 (changes routing & kv heuristics) — needs perf CI run.

infra-bot: CI perf-run #2187 started (bench-1024, bench-512, bench-128).

mario: I'll run a targeted microbench with patched selector and rope patch applied locally and post numbers.

alex: Thanks. If we see p95 drop ~20-30% at 1k we can backport to dedicated hosts. Also keep an eye on chat template mode — the micro-batching semantics there (prepend system + convo history) often shifts effective seq distribution and triggers different kernel choices.

sophie: Noted — I'll add a unit test that simulates chat templates with interleaved small + large turns to validate caching retention.

priya: Also adding a regression test for head_dim alignment matrix so selector doesn't flip on slight metadata differences.

alex: Great. Filing a follow-up to coordinate A/B rollout on dedicated clusters once PR passes. :thumbsup:
